claims: require_cast_manifest never returns None: for {}, None, a non-dict brief and an unrelated brief it returns a FAIL receipt with reason_code CAST_FOUNDATION_MISSING, blocked=true and a reason string that says the absent field is missing input, never an opt-out.

The Skill 75 foundation envelope cannot be emptied into an opt-out: episode_cast_manifest of {}, null, a string, or {"cast": []} each returns FAIL (CAST_FOUNDATION_MISSING or CAST_FOUNDATION_INVALID).

A contract-valid episode_cast_manifest (two entries carrying every CAST_ENTRY_FIELDS member) returns PASS with characters_n=2; an under-specified manifest returns FAIL CAST_FOUNDATION_INVALID and names the missing field (identity_digest) in the reason.

The WW-27 declaration keeps its own verdicts through the required gate: the complete ensemble returns PASS / ENSEMBLE_CAST_OK; a declared-but-broken cast returns FAIL (CAST_NOT_ENSEMBLE or CAST_INCOMPLETE).

validate_authored_lyrics(lines, {}) returns rejected / CAST_FOUNDATION_MISSING with coverage.covered == 0 before any line is judged, and inspect.signature proves it exposes no argument that turns the cast requirement off.
A brief carrying the episode_cast_manifest envelope is rejected through the legacy validate_lyrics surface, so the gate cannot be skipped by changing the brief's shape.
_cast_gate(x, required=True) returns a FAIL receipt, never None, for {}, {'cast': None}, {'characters': []}, 'not-a-brief', 0 and [].

No regression for existing callers: a plain cast-less legacy brief and an H7 names-only characters list still return cast_decision=None and outcome=ok, and a declared cast is still gated on the legacy surface.
No owned or surrounding test regressed: every suite above returned RC=0 except the two character_bible files proven to fail identically on pristine origin/main.
not_claimed: S75-T13 / S75-A13 are NOT accepted, verified or closed. The acceptance decision stays with the owner (Trevor); D-9 (no owner recorded) remains open and D-3 (emergency FACTORY-GATE-OWNER handoff) remains unverified.

No factory.py, registry.json or method_plan.py wiring was added. T13's exact deliverable (connect research->cast/world->plan->script/lyrics->whole-package approval->music and replace placeholder registry commands) requires the exact emergency-owner handoff, so the candidate stops at the gate itself.
No music-before-elected-full-script-approval enforcement and no continuity-bible/music dependency change: those are other facets of S75-A13 and are out of this candidate's scope.

The legacy validate_lyrics surface still reads a plain cast-less brief as before by design (WW-27/H7 compatibility). The required gate is entered through validate_authored_lyrics, require_cast_manifest, or any brief carrying episode_cast_manifest; a caller that never uses those entries is not yet forced to the gate.
Two pre-existing character_bible test failures (circular pdf_writer import) are not fixed here; they are baseline failures on origin/main.

999 flavor and installed-skill packaging were not exercised; this candidate is ONB-repo only and was measured in the lane worktree without checkout, stash, reset or clean of the shared operator checkout.
shape_statement: For any brief, _cast_gate refuses (verdict FAIL, blocked true, a named CAST_FOUNDATION_MISSING / CAST_FOUNDATION_INVALID / WW-27 cast code) when the cast foundation is absent or invalid, and returns None only on the one documented legacy validation surface with no cast declaration and no foundation envelope; the authoring entry validate_authored_lyrics takes no argument that can disable it.
